data.raw_text:
This is from Philippines.

Every vendor here must display Sanitary Permit + Health Certificates (renewed every 6 months) fire safety and other permits. Strict hygiene rules, clean water, gloves, waste management → result? Clean, safe, delicious street food you can trust.

Now compare to India 🇮🇳
Dirty utensils, open drains, no gloves/hairnets, reused oil, questionable water… food that can make you seriously sick. @fssaiindia has rules on paper, but enforcement is weak  many vendors unregistered, inspections rare.
